title: Expense splitter frontend (UI for adding expenses, listing expenses, and viewing settlements)
declaredInterface: React SPA on Vite dev server (proxying /api to backend :3001 or calling :3001 directly with CORS)
assumptions: Frontend built with React + Vite + Tailwind/modern CSS (or lightweight modern stack) communicating with the Express backend on port 3001. Features: Add Expense form with dynamic participants, Expenses list with delete action, Balances summary showing net balances and simplified debt settlement list, and quick suggestions for participants.
